title: Aerovia ONNX model io
description: Contract model-io 1.0.0: the input and output tensors of an exported ONNX file (data/models/*/*.onnx), as read from the graph with the onnx package: one input (a batch of log resistance ratios, one per branch) and three outputs in graph order (rawFlows and flows per branch, pressures per node), all float32 with a symbolic batch axis. The registry entry of the file declares the same names and widths (tests/contracts/test_model_io.py compares them); the browser reads the file through ONNX Runtime Web (frontend/src/learned/index.ts).
